## RBI facility utilization
Financial year No. of days during which balance was
maintained without any advance from
RBI (SDF, WMA and OD)
2020-21 34
2021-22 43
2022-23 24
2023-24 31
2024-25 8
It is worrisome that the State Government could maintain minimum cash balance without resorting to taking advances from RBI for only 8 days. Even during 2020-21, when the State Government had to endure severe cash shortage owing to outbreak of Covid-19 pandemic and the lockdown, when the RBI enhanced the SDF, WMA and OD facility available to States, we could manage to have cash balance for 34 days without resorting to RBI advances. Even during those difficult times, the TDP, which was then in opposition made a hue and cry about the usage of the RBI facility. They went to the extent of saying that if such heavy usage of RBI facility was made, then it signals collapse of financial system in the State. Now, the usage has increased and the No. of days when RBI facility was utilized has increased to 357 days of 365 days during 2024-25. What has the TDP to say now? [^1]: Source - CAG accounts 5
